comments.author: benkarst
comments.story: Brian Eno: We've been living happily with AI for thousands of years
comments.why: Example of the hidden processes behind making a chicken sandwich
comments.text: Thoughtful article. Eno refers to hidden processes in systems as AI hinting at their similarity. I am assuming there are already digital systems in place that monitor "hidden" processes that make a chicken sandwich for example ( [VIDEO] ). Such systems could monitor data points and possibly forecast the price (or a great many things) of a chicken sandwich.
